data.summary_en: AgenticRoboRL post-trains robot planners with supervised fine-tuning and multi-round RL, linking interaction records to task outcomes via harness-specific adapters for different execution mechanisms; on LIBERO-PRO, without external memory, it lifts a 9B-parameter planner's success rate 18.1%→71.0%, near Codex (GPT-5.5) with external memory at 72.1%.
